C122.effective_capacitance_assessment: TI TPS7A02 requires ≥0.5uF effective output capacitance for stability and recommends 1uF or more for best transient response. Taiyo Yuden's part-specific DC-bias curve shows approximately 0.9uF remains at 3.3V (nominal curve); applying -10% initial tolerance gives approximately 0.81uF before temperature/aging variation. This clears the stability minimum but does not guarantee 1uF effective. Confirm the actual output rail and total capacitance margin.

C101.status: Exact fit and current catalog listing. Manufacturer package is 3.2 x 2.5 x 2.5mm. Samsung's DC-bias data are typical design-reference data, not guaranteed minimum capacitance. For 9V VBUS, qualify effective capacitance from the Samsung DC-bias curve/design simulation against BQ25895 input-capacitance requirement; do not treat 22uF nominal as guaranteed under bias. Installed on C101 and parallel C108 (qty 2 total); total nominal capacitance 44uF. Added parallel branch to address limited typical effective-capacitance margin at 9V. Typicals are not guaranteed; doubled input capacitance increases stored charge and inrush at a given voltage.

C109.status: Exact fit nominally. Samsung typical curve at REGN=6V suggests ~3.98uF at 25C before tolerance/temp/aging; after illustrative 0.90 initial and 0.85 temperature factors ~3.04uF. This is materially below 10uF nominal; do not treat the numeric typical as guaranteed. Also evaluated 16V-rated same-value alternative CL21B106KOQNNNE (C95841), which improves typical retention only modestly (~4.33uF at6V; 3.31uF after same factors). Installed on C102 and parallel C109 (qty 2 total); total nominal capacitance 20uF. Parallel branch raises effective REGN capacitance; doubled REGN capacitance increases charging current/charge during startup. Typical curve values remain non-guaranteed.
